overview: Umbrella review of systematic reviews of link worker social prescribing published from 2017, with quality appraisal of each review, a citation matrix of primary studies and separate certainty ratings per outcome.
population: Systematic reviews (including realist and economic reviews) of social prescribing delivered through a link worker to adults, published January 2017 to December 2026.
exposure: Link worker social prescribing compared with usual care or no referral, as defined by each review; direct clinician referral schemes are excluded unless reported separately.
procedures: The GP searches four databases and two review registers with a dated strategy; the analyst manages records. Two readers (the GP and a second clinician for a random 30 percent) screen and appraise reviews with AMSTAR 2. A citation matrix lists every primary study against every review; the corrected covered area is calculated overall and per outcome. For each outcome, conclusions are summarised from the highest-quality, most recent review with the least overlap, and certainty is graded with GRADE.

outcomes.name: Self-reported wellbeing
outcomes.measure: Direction, size and certainty of effects reported by reviews, counting each primary study once
outcomes.why: The outcome most reviews report and most patients care about.

outcomes.name: Loneliness
outcomes.measure: Pooled or narrative effects from reviews of controlled studies

outcomes.name: Primary care consultation rate
outcomes.measure: Rate ratios reported by reviews, graded by comparison type

outcomes.name: Overlap of primary studies
outcomes.measure: Corrected covered area overall and per outcome
outcomes.why: Shows how much double counting drives conclusions.

feasibility: Two sessions a week for 16 weeks and analyst support fit an overview of about 15 reviews; no patient data are needed.
biasMitigation: Each primary study counted once in the citation matrix
Second reader for 30 percent of screening and appraisal
Reviews by the umbrella team's own authors excluded from appraisal by that author

biasFlags.label: Overlap between reviews
biasFlags.note: Corrected covered area expected to be very high.

biasFlags.label: Single main reviewer
biasFlags.note: Partly addressed by the 30 percent second reading.

biasFlags.label: Publication bias in local evaluations
biasFlags.note: Positive local reports are more likely to be written up.

flags: Costs described narratively, not as an outcome
parsimony.simplestPath: One overview, one citation matrix, four outcomes graded separately.

theoreticalFramework: The realist programme theory from the retrieved realist review is used only to organise findings on who benefits.
summary: Umbrella review with overlap measured and outcomes graded separately.
